notes: 修复跨重启僵死 watcher 占锁导致「勾了自动拉取/推送、点 × 关闭仍不触发」：auto-sync.lock 写入 watchPid=当前 DSH pid；spawnWatcher 复用锁前先判僵死（watchPid 缺失或进程已退出→杀旧 watcher、清锁、重排），只在 DSH+watcher 都活着且 mode 相同时才复用；post-exit wait 段发现 WatchPid 已死但进程名有新实例且全部晚于本等待进程时，判定过期 watcher，写日志、清自己的锁并 exit 3 让位。post-exit.ps1 同步进配置仓库执行体镜像。保留 0.3.93 的点 × 判一次并排队行为。
notesEn: Fix cross-restart stale watchers holding the lock, which made 'auto pull/push enabled but clicking × still triggered nothing': auto-sync.lock now records watchPid=current DSH pid; spawnWatcher checks for staleness before reuse (missing watchPid or dead DSH pid → kill old watcher, clear lock, re-queue), and only reuses when both DSH and watcher are alive with the same mode. The post-exit wait phase, on seeing WatchPid gone but same-named processes that all started after this waiter, treats itself as a stale watcher: logs, removes its own lock, and exits 3 to yield. post-exit.ps1 is mirrored into the config repo runtime. Keeps the 0.3.93 close-click check-and-queue behavior.
